source_embedding: Enterprise chart vector (a,b) is embedded on the orthogonal compatibility side as a*(1,0)+b*(1/2,sqrt(3)/2); this is source-side comparison geometry only.

general_formula.weight: w=r*Delta with Delta in (0,pi_source/3] on a canonical sector

symbol_formulas.Q: Q=a^2+a*b+b^2; Q appears only in this source compatibility formula, not as Enterprise length

axis_formula: For the first canonical turn (r,0)->(r-1,1), tan Delta_axis(r)=sqrt(3)/(2*r-1).

central_formula.selected_turn: Choose the canonical central symbol-2 turn whose start has m=a+b=M_N(r)=r+J_N(r) and d=a-b in {1,2}; existence follows from the AH left-half termination rule.

firewall: All square roots/angles here are source-side comparison quantities and do not enter the AL target resolver or AK turn machine.
